evals.prompt: Convert a local PDF to Markdown, preserve extracted images/assets, and give me the metadata JSON path.
evals.expected_output: Uses the anything2md decoder script, routes the PDF through MinerU precision extraction, writes Markdown plus metadata/assets, and reports conversion risks.
expectations: Reports extracted asset location or clear MinerU failure

evals.prompt: Turn this saved ordinary article HTML export into Markdown for agent review. Do not use plugins, URI conversion, cloud parsing, MinerU, or MarkItDown fallback.
evals.expected_output: Routes local HTML article input to the built-in article decoder, keeps plugins/URI/cloud/MinerU/MarkItDown disabled, writes Markdown and metadata, and reports paths.
expectations: Selects decoder article for local HTML
Does not route to MinerU or MarkItDown

evals.prompt: Prepare a DOCX for a portable knowledge archive: convert it to Markdown, archive the original only after successful decode, and keep metadata/assets under the archive root.
evals.expected_output: Uses the archive profile, routes DOCX through MinerU, writes decoded Markdown, archives the original under the configured anything2md archive layout after success, and reports metadata/assets.
expectations: Uses --profile archive explicitly or relies on --profile auto with --knowledge-root/--archive-root/--archive-original
Uses --knowledge-root, --archive-root, and --archive-original only for archive workflows
Archives the original only after successful decode

evals.prompt: Convert this trusted ordinary web article URL to Markdown. It is an article page, not a landing page or app UI; keep only the core article content.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/decode.py with --allow-uri, routes the HTTP(S) URL through the built-in article decoder, removes page chrome/noise, writes Markdown plus metadata, and does not use MinerU crawl.

evals.prompt: Convert this WeChat public article URL to Markdown and preserve the article body/images as the WeChat page provides them.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/decode.py with --allow-uri, routes the mp.weixin.qq.com URL through the built-in WeChat article branch, extracts title/account/body, handles lazy images, writes Markdown plus metadata, and does not use MinerU crawl.
expectations: Selects decoder article with articleIsWeChat true

evals.prompt: Convert this trusted Bilibili video URL to Markdown. I need the complete transcript and video metadata, not a webpage article extraction or summary.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/decode.py with --allow-uri, routes the Bilibili video URL through the built-in Bilibili decoder, extracts a Chinese subtitle/transcript or translates a non-Chinese subtitle to Chinese, writes Markdown plus metadata, and does not use article extraction, MinerU, or MarkItDown.
expectations: Prefers Chinese subtitles and records translation metadata when non-Chinese subtitles are translated
Does not route to article, MinerU, or MarkItDown
Does not generate an AI summary or summary placeholder

evals.prompt: Convert this trusted Bilibili video URL where only English subtitles are available. The output Markdown still must be Chinese.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/decode.py with --allow-uri, routes through the Bilibili decoder, translates the non-Chinese subtitle to Chinese with an available translation backend, records original subtitle and translation metadata, and fails clearly if translation is unavailable instead of emitting English Markdown.
expectations: Does not return non-Chinese transcript Markdown as success
Records bilibiliTranslatedToChinese and bilibiliTranslationBackend when translation occurs
Fails clearly if no Chinese subtitle and no translation backend are available
